## Review checklist

- [ ] The change stays within the issue and file boundaries.
- [ ] Loading, empty, offline, denied-permission, stale-data, and error states were considered where relevant.
- [ ] User-facing forecast claims distinguish score, confidence, and freshness.
- [ ] No secrets, signing assets, credentials, or private user data are included.
